reports.title: Does past behaviour predict future performance?
reports.summary: The adaptive target and the risk throttle rest on different assumptions. One is sound and undersampled; the other costs money under the null and has no evidence behind it.
reports.author: Claude

reports.title: The 09:30 open as a second strategy
reports.summary: A 10-minute opening-range breakout makes +5.67R over 13 trades and still loses money — because at $500 the notional cap sizes 10 of them.
reports.author: Claude

reports.title: "Open Drive: picking the day's stock"
reports.summary: The 09:30 strategy lost money by picking the wrong stock each day — its "first to trigger" rule is an alphabetical lottery landing on cap-crushed 1%-risk trades. A sizing-aware pick turns the same month positive at half the drawdown.
reports.author: Claude

reports.title: The plan, and what the projection assumes
reports.summary: The commentary that used to live on the Plan page and the Projection view: the five standing orders and why each exists, and the assumptions every projected number rests on.
reports.author: Claude

reports.title: The 2-trade-a-day cap: is it wasting capital?
reports.summary: It has never dropped a setup, and a 75/25 first/second split changes almost nothing — because the notional cap is not what limits position size.
reports.author: Claude

reports.title: Time of day: when the entry fires, and what it's worth
reports.summary: 21 days, 787 triggered setups. Within the pre-market no window is statistically distinguishable from another — but entries decay monotonically through the session, after 11:00 significantly so, and R-normalisation hides a large percentage-move effect.
reports.author: Claude

reports.author: Claude

reports.title: Does a smaller float buy a bigger Max R?
reports.summary: Float is a tail effect, not a gradient — it barely moves the median trade but roughly doubles the odds of a big one, and the break is at ~5M shares, not at the 20M gate.
reports.author: Claude

reports.title: Engine feature analysis: which gates and score terms actually earn their keep
reports.summary: 1050 setups, 21 days. The gate set only separates inside the window the book trades; a third of the score's weight is inert; and the strongest signal in the data — stop distance — isn't a feature at all.
reports.author: Claude
